# Muhamed Nur Beck: AI Automation Manager & Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Muhamed Nur Beck, an AI automation and full-stack developer based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. He builds AI workflow automations (n8n, Zapier, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, RAG, LangChain), full-stack web applications (React, Angular, Spring Boot) and CRM/ATS integrations (HubSpot, RecruitCRM, Personio, Greenhouse). Available for freelance projects in Germany and remote. Speaks German, English and Arabic.

## Key Results

- Reduced recruiting process cycle times by about 80% through n8n and Zapier automation at TOPEOPLE Group GmbH.
- Raised candidate operations automation to about 90% with GPT/LLM solutions (OpenAI, Azure, RAG, LangChain).
- Built an in-house sales and recruiting SaaS end to end (React 19, Supabase, Vercel, Twilio) with multi-tenant RLS and a 9-role permission model.
- Implemented voice AI agents (Twilio/WebRTC, STT/TTS) for support and applicant communication.
- Increased organic traffic by 35% with AI-based SEO workflows at Phoenix Parkservice.
- Master thesis at INFOMOTION: an LLM-based Maven plugin that raised test coverage by 33% and cut unit test writing time by up to 95%.
